__comment: An M3U playlist on the web - an IPTV service's channel list, or any list of streams - in Videos, its groups as sections. The customUI app org.webosports.app.videoauth asks for the playlist's address and calls org.webosports.service.videos/login with this templateId, which reads the list before Accounts stores the account. The address often holds the IPTV service's password, so it is a credential.
__comment2: org.webosports.app.videoauth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs as the customUI app. org.webosports.service.videos reads the credentials for every catalogue call.
